question.text: Which of the following categories is NOT one of the three insurance needs categories identified in the NISM curriculum?

explanation.text: The Logic: The three insurance needs categories as per the NISM curriculum are: (1) Income replacement (replacing income lost due to death/disability), (2) Income protection (protecting income during temporary disability/illness), and (3) Asset protection (protecting physical assets like home, car). Wealth accumulation is an investment objective, not an insurance need. The Trap: Wealth accumulation sounds relevant because many insurance products (ULIPs, endowment plans) have an investment component. However, the curriculum clearly distinguishes insurance needs from investment needs. Insurance is primarily about protection, not wealth creation.
